item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the Advanced Air Sealing upgrade:

- **Eligible homes:** Dwelling units with baseline infiltration **≥6 ACH50**; units below that threshold are excluded.
- **Target leakage:** Eligible units are sealed to **5 ACH50**. ACH50 means air changes per hour measured at a 50-pascal pressure difference. [Release README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf)
- **Coverage:** Approximately **92% of existing dwelling units** in the modeled baseline stock. [Measure documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf)
